title: Alpha diversity
text: Standard tidy input. metadata.tsv must include categorical grouping column compare (group_var, ≥2 levels) – checked validator’s group_column option (see data-format.md).

title: Alpha diversity
text: Observed: richness – count taxa nonzero abundance sample (R: vegan::specnumber(); Python: count nonzero features). Shannon: -sum(p * log(p)) relative proportions p (natural log, matching vegan::diversity(index = "shannon")). Simpson: Gini-Simpson index 1 - sum(p^2) (matching vegan::diversity(index = "simpson")). Faith’s phylogenetic diversity intentionally excluded – needs phylogenetic tree, scope tidy-flat-file library (see data-format.md).

title: Alpha diversity
text: test = "auto" (default) picks Wilcoxon/Mann-Whitney U exactly 2 groups, Kruskal-Wallis 2 – non-parametric, appropriate diversity indices rarely normally distributed. Set test = NULL/None disable. metric literally constant across every sample (zero variance – e.g. identical richness), p-value annotation silently omitted panel rather showing meaningless result.

title: Alpha diversity
text: plot title – bold per-metric facet labels, boxplot + jittered points (jitter x-; y-position always shows real value, never artificially perturbed), test p-value small annotation panel.

title: Alpha diversity
code: data <- mp_read_data("feature_table.tsv", "taxonomy.tsv", "metadata.tsv") mp_alpha_diversity_plot(data, group_var = "Group")

title: Alpha diversity
text: Shannon H. 1948, “Mathematical Theory Communication”, Bell System Technical Journal. Simpson EH. 1949, “Measurement Diversity”, Nature, 163:688. Non-parametric group comparison diversity indices: standard practice, e.g. QIIME2 diversity alpha-group-significance.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: Two separate flat tables, 3-file taxonomy schema: contig_lengths.tsv (Nx curve) – one row per contig: assembly_summary.tsv (summary barplot) – one row per assembly, shaped like QUAST’s report.tsv. QUAST’s column names accepted directly (normalized internally): Assembly_ID, N50, Total_length required (either naming convention); rest optional needed plot via stat_col.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: mp_validate_contig_lengths()/validate_contig_lengths(): required columns; Length numeric positive; duplicate Contig_ID within Assembly_ID. mp_validate_assembly_summary()/validate_assembly_summary(): required columns; N50/Total_length numeric positive; duplicate Assembly_ID.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: Cumulative contig-length distribution: contigs sorted longest--shortest, x = cumulative % total assembly length, y = contig length (log10 scale), one step-line per assembly. Reading x = 50 gives assembly’s N50 – standard QUAST plot, informative single N50 number alone since shows whole length distribution, just one point.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: single QUAST report.tsv statistic (default N50) plotted per assembly plain bar – set stat_col "Total_length", "N_contigs", etc. plot different one.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: title – axis titles, tick labels, (Nx curve ) color legend per assembly.

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
code: contigs <- readr::read_delim("contig_lengths.tsv", delim = "\t") summary_tbl <- readr::read_delim("assembly_summary.tsv", delim = "\t") mp_assembly_nx_plot(contigs) mp_assembly_summary_barplot(summary_tbl, stat_col = "N50")

title: Assembly QC: Nx curve + summary barplot
text: QUAST: Gurevich et al. 2013, Bioinformatics, 29(8):1072-1075. Nx curve / N50 assembly contiguity metric: standard since original genome assembly papers (e.g. human genome draft, IHGSC 2001).

title: Taxa barplot
text: Standard tidy feature_table.tsv + taxonomy.tsv + metadata.tsv (see data-format.md). taxonomy.tsv must include rank plot (default Genus) , using nested legend, grouping rank (default Phylum).

title: Taxa barplot
text: taxa count “top” decided two independent stages: min_rel_abund min_prevalence first narrow field eligible taxa (taxon must pass set), top_n picks abundant among survivors. taxon excluded either stage – failed threshold, simply outside top N passed – ends other_label identically. Set top_n = NULL/None show every taxon clears thresholds, uncapped. standard core-microbiome filtering logic (cf. phyloseq::filter_taxa, microbiome::core, Shade & Handelsman 2012, Environmental Microbiology – “beyond Venn diagram”).

title: Taxa barplot
text: Real 16S taxonomy tables routinely blank, NA, uncultured genus calls. Left -, genus-level barplot silently drops abundance shows meaningless blank segment. default barplot runs “tax-fix” step first: unknown value rank replaced last known ancestor rank, e.g. unclassified genus inside family Lactobacillaceae labeled Unclassified_Lactobacillaceae rather NA. Cascading unknowns (genus species missing) anchor true ancestor rather chaining onto ’s fabricated labels. mirrors tax_fix() approach microViz R package (Barnett et al. 2021, Bioinformatics).

title: Taxa barplot
text: group_rank set, taxa ordered every group’s members stay contiguous (groups within-group taxa ordered descending abundance), group gets base hue members shaded hue (family related colors), legend shows group name bold header first member – convention used microbiome barplots R ggnested package. Set nested_legend = FALSE flat legend (plain labels, one hue per taxon, grouping).

title: Taxa barplot
text: title/subtitle/caption ever drawn – axis titles, tick labels, legend – figure publication-ready returned.

title: Taxa barplot
code: data <- mp_read_data("feature_table.tsv", "taxonomy.tsv", "metadata.tsv") mp_taxa_barplot(data, rank = "Genus", group_rank = "Phylum", top_n = 10)

title: Taxa barplot
text: Standard stacked taxa barplot: QIIME2 taxa-bar-plot, phyloseq::plot_bar(), MicrobiomeAnalyst. Nested/grouped legend: ggnested (gmteunisse/ggnested). Taxonomy fallback labeling: tax_fix() microViz (Barnett DJM et al. 2021, Bioinformatics, 37(16)).

title: Beta diversity
text: Standard tidy input. metadata.tsv must include categorical grouping column (group_var) used coloring, ellipses, PERMANOVA.

title: Beta diversity
text: phylogenetic (UniFrac) distance – Bray-Curtis/Jaccard , consistent rest library (tree-based analysis treated separate step).

title: Beta diversity
text: R uses vegan::adonis2() directly. Python implements one-way pseudo-F permutation test first principles (Anderson 2001): observed pseudo-F distance-based sums squares, compared pseudo-F many random relabelings group variable (distance matrix held fixed) get p-value – extra dependency (scikit-bio avoided deliberately; core math adonis2/scikit-bio’s permanova use).

title: Beta diversity
text: PCoA classical (metric) MDS: double-centre squared distance matrix, eigendecompose, scale eigenvectors sqrt(eigenvalue) – R uses stats::cmdscale(), Python implements identical linear-algebra directly (extra dependency). NMDS non-metric MDS (Kruskal’s stress minimization) – R uses vegan::metaMDS(), Python uses sklearn.manifold.MDS(metric_mds=False).

title: Beta diversity
text: plot title ordinary sense – PERMANOVA R² p-value (NMDS stress) essential statistical content , decorative chrome, ’re shown subtitle/title-left annotation even though every plot library omits titles.

title: Beta diversity
code: data <- mp_read_data("feature_table.tsv", "taxonomy.tsv", "metadata.tsv") mp_beta_diversity_plot(data, group_var = "Group", method = "bray", ordination = "pcoa") mp_beta_diversity_plot(data, group_var = "Group", method = "bray", ordination = "nmds")

title: Beta diversity
text: PERMANOVA: Anderson MJ. 2001, “new method non-parametric multivariate analysis variance”, Austral Ecology, 26(1):32-46. NMDS: Kruskal JB. 1964, “Nonmetric multidimensional scaling”, Psychometrika, 29(1):1-27. Bray-Curtis: Bray JR, Curtis JT. 1957, Ecological Monographs, 27(4):325-349.

Rows ordered grouped group_rank block (blocks within-block taxa ordered descending total abundance), ordering convention used barplot, barplot bubbleplot data present taxa consistent order.

title: Functional profile barplot/heatmap
text: per-sample gene/KO count table (Feature_ID + per-sample counts) joined functional annotation table (Feature_ID + hierarchy columns) shape-identical feature_table.tsv + taxonomy.tsv. Duplicating whole barplot/heatmap engine just code twice.

title: Functional profile barplot/heatmap
text: Two tables, 3-file taxonomy schema: gene_count_table.tsv – one row per gene/KO/feature, shape feature_table.tsv: Feature_ID + one column per sample. Comes read quantifier run predicted genes/ORFs (e.g. featureCounts, Salmon, CoverM) – library doesn’t quantification, plotting. function_annotation.tsv – Feature_ID + functional hierarchy columns, whichever annotation tool used: eggNOG-mapper (*.emapper.annotations): use column names directly – COG_category (broad functional category, single letter, e.g. "C" = energy production; "S" = function unknown – real, distinct COG category, thing hit), KEGG_ko, Description. Defaults: rank = "KEGG_ko", group_rank = "COG_category". KofamScan (mapper.tsv/detail-tsv): gives flat KO assignment, broader category (Feature_ID/KO/KO_definition). Use rank = "KO", group_rank = NULL/None, nested_legend = FALSE/False (nothing nest ). metadata optional (needed facet_var/sample_order metadata column) – auto-stubbed sample columns supplied.

title: Functional profile barplot/heatmap
text: gene COG hit (common – eggNOG-mapper leaves COG_category blank, "S", nothing matched) resolved way unclassified genus taxonomic side: [mp_tax_fix()]/tax_fix() labels "Unclassified". Internally wired via tax_fix_ranks (new parameter added taxa engine alongside feature) fallback machinery works arbitrary column names, just fixed 16S rank set.

title: Functional profile barplot/heatmap
code: gene_counts <- readr::read_delim("gene_count_table.tsv", delim = "\t") annotation <- readr::read_delim("function_annotation.tsv", delim = "\t")  # eggNOG-mapper shape mp_function_barplot(gene_counts, annotation, rank = "KEGG_ko", group_rank = "COG_category") mp_function_heatmap(gene_counts, annotation, rank = "KEGG_ko")  # KofamScan shape (flat KO annotation, no broader category) mp_function_barplot(gene_counts, annotation_kofam, rank = "KO", group_rank = NULL, nested_legend = FALSE)

title: Functional profile barplot/heatmap
text: eggNOG-mapper: Cantalapiedra CP et al. 2021, Molecular Biology Evolution, 38(12):5825-5829. KofamScan/KofamKOALA: Aramaki T et al. 2020, Bioinformatics, 36(7):2251-2252. HUMAnN3 (alternative, pre-computed pathway-abundance route rather gene-level annotation): Beghini F et al. 2021, eLife, 10:e65088.

title: Taxa heatmap
text: min_rel_abund/min_prevalence narrow candidate taxa first (taxon must pass set), top_n picks abundant among survivors – see barplot.md full rationale. Unlike barplot, taxa don’t make cut simply shown (“” row).

title: Taxa heatmap
text: Samples clustered Bray-Curtis dissimilarity relative abundance – community-ecology standard compositional microbiome data (used default vegan, ampvis2::amp_heatmap, QIIME2 beta diversity). Taxa clustered Euclidean distance transformed (CLR log10) values actually shown, matching pheatmap / ComplexHeatmap default displayed matrix.

title: Taxa heatmap
text: CLR (centered log-ratio) compositional-data-appropriate transform microbiome relative abundances (Gloor et al. 2017, Frontiers Microbiology – “microbiome datasets compositional”) default. log10(x + pseudocount) offered simpler, familiar alternative exploratory use.

title: Taxa heatmap

title: Taxa heatmap
text: Bray-Curtis clustering convention: ampvis2::amp_heatmap, vegan::vegdist. CLR transform compositional microbiome data: Gloor GB et al. 2017, Frontiers Microbiology, 8:2224. General clustered-heatmap layout: pheatmap, ComplexHeatmap (Gu Z et al. 2016, Bioinformatics).

title: MAG quality plot
text: single flat table, one row per MAG/bin – 3-file taxonomy schema used marker-gene plots. Shaped like CheckM2’s quality_report.tsv CheckM (v1)’s qa/bin_stats table; column names either tool accepted directly (normalized internally): Completeness, Contamination, Genome_Size required (either naming convention); everything else optional used pass size_col/color_col (e.g. taxonomy column GTDB-Tk coloring).

title: MAG quality plot
text: mp_mag_quality_distribution() / mag_quality_distribution() takes table bins count; size_col/color_col (’s histogram, scatter).

title: MAG quality plot
text: Reference lines (shaded high-quality region) follow MIMAG standard (Bowers et al. 2017, Nature Biotechnology – “Minimum information single amplified genome metagenome-assembled genome”): High quality: completeness ≥ 90%, contamination < 5%. Medium quality: completeness ≥ 50%, contamination < 10%. : low quality.

title: MAG quality plot
text: title – axis titles, tick labels, (color_col set) color legend, plus size legend size_col set. mp_mag_quality_distribution() uses per-panel bold labels (“Completeness (%)” / “Contamination (%)”) way barplot/bubbleplot use bold facet strip labels – plot title.

title: MAG quality plot
code: mag <- readr::read_delim("mag_quality.tsv", delim = "\t") mp_mag_quality_plot(mag, size_col = "Genome_Size", color_col = "Phylum") mp_mag_quality_distribution(mag)

title: MAG quality plot
text: MIMAG quality-tier standard: Bowers RM et al. 2017, Nature Biotechnology, 35(8):725-731. CheckM2: Chklovski et al. 2023, Nature Methods. CheckM (v1): Parks DH et al. 2015, Genome Research, 25(7):1043-1055.

title: Getting started with microplotr
text: Taxonomy — vignette("barplot"), vignette("heatmap"), vignette("bubbleplot"), vignette("gradient"), vignette("alpha_diversity"), vignette("beta_diversity"), vignette("treemap"). Functional profiles (eggNOG-mapper/KofamScan-shaped) — vignette("function_profile") (barplot/heatmap/treemap wrappers around taxa engine). Metagenomics — vignette("mag_quality") (CheckM/CheckM2), vignette("assembly") (QUAST-shaped Nx curve + summary). Every plot resolves missing/unclassified annotation via mp_tax_fix(), supports abundance/prevalence filtering via mp_filter_taxa(), returns plain ggplot2 object can extend (p + ggplot2::theme(...) etc.) — nothing static image.

title: Taxa / functional treemap
text: [mp_taxa_barplot()]/taxa_barplot() (taxonomic) [mp_function_barplot()]/function_barplot() (functional) – reuses rank/group_rank/filtering/tax-fix conventions , just rendered treemap instead barplot.

title: Taxa / functional treemap
text: Area = relative abundance, mean across samples (summed) total area ~100% regardless sample count – comparable barplot’s per-sample relative abundance (%), just aggregated across whole dataset rather shown per sample. Rectangles grouped group_rank bordered outer region per group (bold label top-left) squarified-packed rank rectangles inside, colored group. Set group_rank = NULL/None flat treemap (one color per taxon, grouping borders). Every label clipped rectangle, long names narrow rectangles cropped rather bleeding neighboring cells figure – external legend; every rectangle labeled directly, way Krona charts read.

title: Taxa / functional treemap
code: data <- mp_read_data("feature_table.tsv", "taxonomy.tsv", "metadata.tsv") mp_taxa_treemap(data, rank = "Genus", group_rank = "Phylum")  # functional data (eggNOG-mapper shape) mp_function_treemap(gene_counts, annotation, rank = "KEGG_ko", group_rank = "COG_category")

title: Taxa / functional treemap
text: Krona: interactive hierarchical taxonomic/functional visualization (Ondov BD et al. 2011, BMC Bioinformatics, 12:385) – treemap targets use case (readable hierarchical composition one view) static figure. Treemap layout: Bruls M, Huizing K, van Wijk J. 2000, “Squarified Treemaps”, Eurographics. R implementation: treemapify (Wilkins D). Python: squarify.
